notes.title: Bug Fixes 2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the tutorial softlocked the whole game
[*]Fixed a bug where the tutorial would not be completed even when the lava element was already created
[/list]

You'll have to reset the save to make this change work.(Options > Reset Save)

We are still looking and trying to fix some bugs, if you found any, feel free to post it in the community hub!
